source: A continuous function on a closed interval attains a maximum. This theorem does not require the function to be differentiable throughout the interval. The maximum need not occur at an endpoint.

source: The derivative determines a local rate of change, not the accumulated change over the entire interval. Integration can recover the accumulated change when the required hypotheses hold.
